skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the structure and management system of joint-stock companies and listed companies on stock exchanges.
Comprehend financial reporting systems and key financial health indicators for companies.
Learn methods to estimate market value of companies and valuation techniques.
Understand the relationship between company value, capital structure, and cost of capital according to Modigliani-Miller theorems.
Apply CAPM to determine beta values for companies with 100% equity.
Analyze the effects of tax shields on investment groups and optimal capital structures.
Utilize valuation models such as Gordon Growth Model for dividend policy and capital raising strategies.
Develop skills in financial modeling to value and measure risk for companies using Excel.
Extract and utilize data from financial statements for valuation and risk management purposes.
Enhance abilities in independent learning, teamwork, personal responsibility, and group accountability.
Improve critical thinking and problem-solving skills in financial contexts.
Develop effective presentation and communication skills for group projects.
